scanNote:
8-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (55-bet). Chap yarmi OCh KO'K fonda.

Yuqorida o'ngda 'A Brush with Danger' va BINAFShA yorliqda oq '8'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Reading'.
4) 'Read the story and choose the correct answers (a, b or c) to questions 1 - 4, then explain the words in bold.'
   HIKOYa (oq qog'oz, yirtiq chegara): qalin sarlavha 'The Giant Squid'. Yetti xatboshi, qalin so'zlar: shore, existed, set off, cast, fishing line, rocking, curled, lifted, distance, reached, except for, scientist, colleagues, In the end, benefitted, became.
   To'rt savol (a/b/c):
   1 At the beginning of the story, Jim ... a believed in sea monsters. b had seen lots of sea monsters. c didn't think the sea monster was real.
   2 What scared the giant squid away? a a school of dolphins b some whales c a sea monster
   3 How did the tourists feel when they heard Jim's story? a amused b scared c angry
   4 What happened to Jim's business after he saw the squid? a The scientists bought it. b It improved. c He lost it.

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development'.
5) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Qiya: school, popular, sea, fishing, guided. 1 ... tours 2 a ... monster 3 a ... rod 4 a ... of whales 5 a ... attraction
6) 'Fill in: SET OFF, COLLEAGUES, SHORE, SPOT.' 1 There were a lot of small boats near the ...... . 2 The photographer ...... to take pictures of the scenery. 3 They chose a quiet ...... for their picnic. 4 I'm Dr Stuart and these are my ...... .
7) 'Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' 1 to stop ... a place; 2 to rock ... side ... side; 3 ... the distance; 4 except ... sb; 5 ... search ... sth; 6 to search ... sth; 7 ... the end (= finally); 8 ... an island; 9 to benefit ... sth
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Put the events below in the correct order. Then, use the list of events, and the pictures on p. 54, to help you retell the story.' Sakkiz voqea nuqtali joylar bilan; 'Jim left the tourists on the beach' oldida ko'k qiya '1' turibdi: Jim went fishing. / Jim told the tourists about the incident. / 1 Jim left the tourists on the beach. / A giant squid lifted the boat out of the water. / Jim's guided tours became the island's most popular attraction. / A school of whales appeared. / The scientist and her colleagues didn't find anything. / The giant squid let go of the boat.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '55'.

exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNING TO'LIQ MATNI VA
TARJIMASI.


⚠ 8-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI - HIKOYaDA:

  PAST SIMPLE (asosiy voqealar):
    said, gave, stopped, prepared,
    began, curled, lifted, started,
    appeared, disappeared, reached,
    told, searched, found, became

  PAST PERFECT (undan OLDIN bo'lgan):
    'he HAD never SEEN it himself'
    'He HAD just CAST his fishing
     line when ...'
    'couldn't believe what HAD
     HAPPENED'
    'a scientist who HAD SPENT most
     of her life'
    'the only one who HAD BENEFITTED'

  USED TO (o'tmishdagi odat):
    'He USED TO tell the tourists
     exciting stories'

  ⚠ Keyingi betlarda tushuntiriladi.


⚠ 'KAIKOURA':

  Yangi Zelandiyadagi joy - kitlarni
  kuzatish bilan mashhur.
  ⚠ Kitobda 'island' deyilgan, aslida
  yarim orol.


⚠ 'ARCHITEUTHIS':

  Ulkan kalmarning lotincha ilmiy
  nomi.

points.en: "Kaikoura is New Zealand's most beautiful island," Jim Banning said to the latest group of tourists. "You can often see whales here, too, swimming near the shore."
points.uz: "Kaikoura - Yangi Zelandiyaning eng go'zal oroli, - dedi Jim Banning navbatdagi turistlar guruhiga. - Bu yerda qirg'oq yaqinida suzayotgan kitlarni ham tez-tez ko'rish mumkin".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'the latest group' = eng so'nggi guruh.
⚠ 'the shore' = qirg'oq.

points.en: Jim was a fisherman, but during the summer he gave guided tours of the island. He used to tell the tourists exciting stories about a sea monster which lived off the coast of New Zealand.
points.uz: Jim baliqchi edi, lekin yozda orol bo'ylab gidli sayohatlar o'tkazardi. U turistlarga Yangi Zelandiya qirg'og'i yaqinida yashaydigan dengiz maxluqi haqida qiziqarli hikoyalar aytib berardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'USED TO tell' = aytib berardi (o'tmishdagi
odat).
⚠ 'off the coast' = qirg'oq yaqinida (dengizda).

points.en: Of course, he had never seen it himself and didn't really believe it existed. Still, tourists enjoyed the story, and Jim hoped this would help to improve business.
points.uz: Albatta, u o'zi uni hech qachon ko'rmagan edi va mavjudligiga aslida ishonmasdi. Baribir turistlarga hikoya yoqardi va Jim bu biznesni yaxshilashga yordam beradi deb umid qilardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'he HAD never SEEN' - PAST PERFECT.
⚠ 'to exist' = mavjud bo'lmoq.
⚠ 'still' bu yerda = baribir, shunga qaramay.

points.en: Leaving the tourists on the beach to take some photographs and have lunch, Jim set off to do some fishing on his own for an hour. He stopped at his favourite quiet spot on the other side of the island and prepared his fishing rod. He was happy to be alone for a while.
points.uz: Turistlarni plyajda surat olish va tushlik qilish uchun qoldirib, Jim bir soatga yolg'iz baliq oviga jo'nadi. U orolning narigi tomonidagi sevimli tinch joyida to'xtab, qarmog'ini tayyorladi. Bir muddat yolg'iz qolganidan xursand edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to set off' = yo'lga chiqmoq, jo'namoq.
⚠ 'on his own' = yolg'iz o'zi.
⚠ 'for a while' = bir muddat.

points.en: He had just cast his fishing line into the water when the boat began rocking from side to side. Jim was surprised, then frightened. Suddenly, giant tentacles curled around the sides of the boat and lifted it out of the water.
points.uz: U qarmoq ipini suvga endigina tashlagan edi, qayiq u yoqdan-bu yoqqa chayqala boshladi. Jim hayron bo'ldi, keyin qo'rqib ketdi. To'satdan ulkan chodirlar qayiq atrofiga o'ralib, uni suvdan ko'tardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'HAD just CAST ... WHEN ...' - past perfect
+ past simple: birinchi voqea tugagan edi,
ikkinchisi boshlandi.
⚠ 'to rock from side to side' = chayqalmoq.
⚠ 'to curl around' = o'ralmoq.

points.en: "Help! A giant squid! Somebody help me!" Jim started screaming, but there was no one around.
points.uz: "Yordam! Ulkan kalmar! Kimdir yordam bering!" - Jim baqira boshladi, lekin atrofda hech kim yo'q edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to scream' = qichqirmoq.
⚠ 'there was no one around' = atrofda hech kim
yo'q edi.

points.en: Suddenly, a school of whales appeared in the distance. The squid let go of the boat and quickly disappeared. Jim couldn't believe what had happened. He looked at the water, then quickly started the boat engine.
points.uz: To'satdan uzoqda kitlar to'dasi paydo bo'ldi. Kalmar qayiqni qo'yib yubordi va tezda g'oyib bo'ldi. Jim nima bo'lganiga ishonolmasdi. U suvga qaradi, so'ng tezda qayiq motorini yoqdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'in the distance' = uzoqda.
⚠ 'to let go of' = qo'yib yubormoq.
⚠ 'what HAD HAPPENED' - past perfect.

points.en: When he reached the beach, he told the tourists what had happened. Everybody started laughing, except for a middle aged woman. "You've just met Architeuthis, the giant squid!" she said.
points.uz: Plyajga yetib borgach, u turistlarga nima bo'lganini aytib berdi. Hamma kula boshladi, o'rta yoshli ayoldan tashqari. "Siz hozirgina Architeuthis - ulkan kalmarni uchratdingiz!" - dedi u.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'except for' = ... dan tashqari.
⚠ 'middle aged' = o'rta yoshli.
⚠ "You've just met" - present perfect + just.

points.en: She explained that she was a scientist who had spent most of her life in search of this squid. She was waiting for her colleagues to arrive. "Did you take any photographs?" she asked excitedly. "Of course not!" said Jim. "Who would take pictures at a time like that? I'm just glad I'm alive to tell the story."
points.uz: U hayotining ko'p qismini shu kalmarni qidirishga sarflagan olim ekanini tushuntirdi. U hamkasblarining kelishini kutayotgan edi. "Surat oldingizmi?" - deb so'radi u hayajon bilan. "Albatta yo'q! - dedi Jim. - Bunday paytda kim surat olardi? Hikoyani aytib berish uchun tirik qolganimdan xursandman".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'who HAD SPENT' - past perfect.
⚠ 'in search of' = ... ni qidirib.
⚠ 'a colleague' = hamkasb, /ˈkɒliːɡ/.
⚠ 'Who would take ...?' - ritorik savol.

points.en: The team of scientists searched for the giant squid for two months, but they found nothing. In the end, the only one who had benefitted from this was Jim. His guided tours became the most popular attraction on the island.
points.uz: Olimlar jamoasi ulkan kalmarni ikki oy qidirdi, lekin hech narsa topmadi. Oxir-oqibat, bundan foyda ko'rgan yagona odam Jim bo'ldi. Uning gidli sayohatlari oroldagi eng mashhur diqqatga sazovor joyga aylandi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'in the end' = oxir-oqibat, nihoyat.
⚠ 'to benefit FROM' = ... dan foyda ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'who HAD BENEFITTED' - past perfect.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story and choose the correct answers (a, b or c) to questions 1 - 4.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing va 1-4 savollarga to'g'ri javobni (a, b yoki c) tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 c - 'didn't really believe it
      existed'
  2 b - 'a school of whales
      appeared ... The squid let go'
  3 a - 'Everybody started laughing'
      → amused (kulgili tuyuldi)
  4 b - 'His guided tours became the
      most popular attraction' →
      biznes yaxshilandi


⚠ 'TO SCARE AWAY':

  = qo'rqitib haydamoq.
  ⚠ 2-savol: 'What scared the squid
  away?' = kalmarni nima qo'rqitib
  yubordi?


⚠ 'AMUSED':

  = ko'ngli ochilgan, kulgan.
  ⚠ 47-betda ham bor edi.

items.textEn: 1 At the beginning of the story, Jim ...
options: had seen lots of sea monsters
didn't think the sea monster was real
items.answer: didn't think the sea monster was real
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'he had never seen it himself and
didn't really believe it existed'.

items.textEn: 2 What scared the giant squid away?
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'a school of WHALES appeared ... The
squid let go of the boat'.

items.textEn: 3 How did the tourists feel when they heard Jim's story?
items.uz: Turistlar Jimning hikoyasini eshitib o'zlarini qanday his qildi?

items.textEn: 4 What happened to Jim's business after he saw the squid?
items.uz: Kalmarni ko'rgandan keyin Jimning biznesiga nima bo'ldi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'His guided tours became the most
popular attraction' → yaxshilandi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then explain the words in bold.

points.noteUz: ⚠ 'the shore' - 46-betda ham bor edi.

⚠ 'to exist' = mavjud bo'lmoq.
⚠ 'existence' = mavjudlik.

⚠ 'to set off' = jo'namoq.
⚠ set - set - set.

⚠ 'to cast' = tashlamoq, uloqtirmoq.
⚠ 46-betda 'cast a spell' - sehr qilmoq.
⚠ 'line' bu yerda = ip.

⚠ 'to rock' = chayqalmoq, tebranmoq.
⚠ 'rock' (ot) = tosh; 'rock music' - boshqa ma'no.

⚠ 'to curl around' = atrofiga o'ralmoq.
⚠ 'curly hair' = jingalak soch.

⚠ 'to lift' = ko'tarmoq.
⚠ 'a lift' = lift (Britaniya).
⚠ 'in the distance' = uzoqda.
⚠ 'to reach' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ 'except (for)' = ... dan tashqari.
⚠ 'science' → 'scientist'.
⚠ O'qilishi /ˈkɒliːɡz/ - 'kolig'.

⚠ 'in the end' = finally.
⚠ 'at the end OF' = ... ning oxirida - boshqa!

⚠ 'to benefit FROM' = ... dan foyda ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'a benefit' = foyda.
⚠ become - BECAME - become.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA HIKOYaDA BOR.

  GUIDED tours - gidli sayohatlar
  a SEA monster - dengiz maxluqi
  a FISHING rod - qarmoq tayoqchasi
  a SCHOOL of whales - kitlar to'dasi
  a POPULAR attraction - mashhur
     diqqatga sazovor joy


⚠ 'A MONSTER':

  = maxluq, yirtqich.
  ⚠ 'the Loch Ness monster' -
  Beginner kitobidagi hikoya.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: set off, colleagues, shore, spot.
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'ying: set off, colleagues, shore, spot.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SO'Z - TO'RT GAP.

  1 near the SHORE - qirg'oq yaqinida
  2 The photographer SET OFF -
    fotograf jo'nadi
  3 a quiet SPOT - tinch joy
  4 these are my COLLEAGUES - bular
    hamkasblarim


⚠ 'SCENERY':

  = manzara.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'a scene' = sahna, manzara
  (sanaladigan).


⚠ 'TO CHOOSE':

  choose - CHOSE - chosen.
  ⚠ 3-bandda 'chose' - o'tgan zamon.

items.sentence: There were a lot of small boats near the ___ .
items.uz: Qirg'oq yaqinida ko'p kichik qayiqlar bor edi.

items.sentence: The photographer ___ to take pictures of the scenery.
items.uz: Fotograf manzarani suratga olish uchun jo'nadi.

items.sentence: They chose a quiet ___ for their picnic.
items.uz: Ular piknik uchun tinch joy tanlashdi.

items.sentence: I'm Dr Stuart and these are my ___ .
items.uz: Men doktor Styuartman, bular esa hamkasblarim.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI HIKOYaDA.

  to stop AT a place
     - joyda to'xtamoq
  to rock FROM side TO side
     - u yoqdan-bu yoqqa chayqalmoq
  IN the distance
     - uzoqda
  except FOR sb
     - kimdandir tashqari
  IN search OF sth
     - biror narsani qidirib
  to search FOR sth
     - biror narsani qidirmoq
  IN the end (= finally)
     - oxir-oqibat
  ON an island
     - orolda
  to benefit FROM sth
     - biror narsadan foyda ko'rmoq


⚠ 'IN SEARCH OF' va 'SEARCH FOR':

  'in search OF' - ot iborasi
  'to search FOR' - fe'l
  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham 'qidirmoq', lekin
  predloglar BOShQA.


⚠ 'ON AN ISLAND':

  ⚠ Orol uchun 'ON' ('in' EMAS).
  ⚠ 'on the island', 'on Cyprus'.


⚠ 'IN THE END' va 'AT THE END':

  in the end = oxir-oqibat, nihoyat
  at the end of = ... ning oxirida
     ('at the end of the film')
  ⚠ ADAShTIRMANG!

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'stop AT' - matnda: 'He stopped AT his
favourite quiet spot'.
⚠ 'IN search OF this squid' - ot iborasi.

⚠ 'searched FOR the giant squid' - fe'l bilan
'for'.

⚠ 'IN the end' = nihoyat.
⚠ 'at the end of' - boshqa ma'no.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the events below in the correct order.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ VOQEA - HIKOYa TARTIBIDA.

  1 Jim left the tourists on the
    beach. (kitobda berilgan)
  2 Jim went fishing.
  3 A giant squid lifted the boat
    out of the water.
  4 A school of whales appeared.
  5 The giant squid let go of the
    boat.
  6 Jim told the tourists about the
    incident.
  7 The scientist and her colleagues
    didn't find anything.
  8 Jim's guided tours became the
    island's most popular attraction.


⚠ 'AN INCIDENT':

  = voqea, hodisa.
  ⚠ 'an accident' (baxtsiz hodisa)
  bilan adashtirmang.


⚠ 'TO RETELL':

  = qayta aytib bermoq.
  ⚠ 're-' + 'tell'.

pairs.right: Jim left the tourists on the beach.
A giant squid lifted the boat out of the water.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'giant tentacles ... lifted it out of the
water'.
⚠ 'a school of whales appeared in the distance'.

pairs.right: The giant squid let go of the boat.
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'The squid let go of the boat'.

pairs.right: Jim told the tourists about the incident.
pairs.rightUz: Jim turistlarga voqea haqida aytib berdi.
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'he told the tourists what had happened'.

pairs.right: The scientist and her colleagues didn't find anything.
pairs.rightUz: Olim va hamkasblari hech narsa topmadi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'searched ... for two months, but they found
nothing'.

pairs.right: Jim's guided tours became the island's most popular attraction.
pairs.rightUz: Jimning sayohatlari oroldagi eng mashhur diqqatga sazovor joyga aylandi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, use the list of events, and the pictures on p. 54, to help you retell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng voqealar ro'yxati va 54-betdagi suratlardan foydalanib hikoyani qayta aytib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNI QAYTA AYTISh.

⚠ BOG'LOVChILAR:
  First, ... Then, ... Suddenly, ...
  After that, ... In the end, ...

⚠ Hammasi PAST SIMPLE da.
exercises.exampleEn: First, Jim left the tourists on the beach and went fishing.
exercises.exampleUz: Avval Jim turistlarni plyajda qoldirib baliq oviga ketdi.
modelAnswers: First, Jim left the tourists on the beach and went fishing on his own.
Suddenly, a giant squid lifted his boat out of the water.
Then a school of whales appeared, and the squid let go of the boat.
When Jim reached the beach, he told the tourists about the incident, but only a scientist believed him.
The scientist and her colleagues searched for two months, but they didn't find anything.
In the end, Jim's guided tours became the island's most popular attraction.
modelAnswersUz: Avval Jim turistlarni plyajda qoldirib yolg'iz baliq oviga ketdi.
To'satdan ulkan kalmar uning qayig'ini suvdan ko'tardi.
Keyin kitlar to'dasi paydo bo'ldi va kalmar qayiqni qo'yib yubordi.
Jim plyajga yetib borgach, turistlarga voqea haqida aytib berdi, lekin faqat bir olim unga ishondi.
Olim va hamkasblari ikki oy qidirishdi, lekin hech narsa topishmadi.
Oxir-oqibat Jimning sayohatlari oroldagi eng mashhur diqqatga sazovor joyga aylandi.

patterns.exampleEn: He used to tell the tourists exciting stories.
patterns.exampleUz: U turistlarga qiziqarli hikoyalar aytib berardi.

patterns.exampleEn: He had just cast his fishing line when the boat began rocking.
patterns.exampleUz: U qarmoq ipini endigina tashlagan edi, qayiq chayqala boshladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PAST PERFECT + when + PAST SIMPLE: birinchi
voqea tugagan, ikkinchisi boshlandi.

Everybody started laughing, except for a middle aged woman.
